name: @the-40-thieves/alexandria-mcp
description: 152-source digital library MCP server. Natural language search across academic papers, public domain books, legal records, government archives, and software documentation.

tools.name: library_list_sources
tools.description: List all 152 sources with descriptions and full-text capabilities

tools.name: library_ask
tools.description: Natural language search: routes a query to the best sources, searches in parallel, returns unified deduplicated results

tools.name: library_search
tools.description: Search a specific source by title, author, or keywords

tools.name: library_read
tools.description: Fetch full text or metadata for an item

tools.name: library_index
tools.description: Dry run: chunk and score text quality without writing anything

tools.name: library_ingest
tools.description: Chunk, embed, and store an item in the operator's vector database

tools.name: library_recommend
tools.description: Get similar papers via Semantic Scholar's recommendation engine

tools.name: library_answer
tools.description: Ask a question and get a synthesized answer with inline citations

tools.name: library_research
tools.description: Recursive multi-round research producing a final cited report

tools.name: library_health_check
tools.description: Report per-source health, merging live and last-probed status

tools.name: library_citations
tools.description: List works an item cites or is cited by, with bibliography export

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API Key
openai_api_key.description: Enables library_ask's query routing and library_ingest's embeddings. Search and read work without it.

alexandria_base_url.title: Alexandria Base URL
alexandria_base_url.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible gateway base URL, used instead of api.openai.com for every LLM/embeddings role.
